T: Nobody puts dessert in a corner.
D: A teen falls for the dance instructor at a family resort in the Catskills.
P: Serve dessert at the final dance.
S: Devilled eggs and smoked salmon on rye, served on silver trays like a 1963 resort.
Ice-cold watermelon cut into thick wedges, topped with crumbled feta, torn mint, a squeeze of lime and a pinch of flaky salt.
the after-hours dance party in the staff cabins
Pretzels and potato chips in bowls, with an onion dip of slow-caramelised onions folded into sour cream with salt and chives.
M: Brisket braised at 150C for 4 hours on onions with stock, tomato paste and paprika, sliced, with the juices.
Two thin patties smashed on a hot griddle, American cheese melted on top, pickles and mustard on soft buns, wrapped in paper.
W: she carried a watermelon, now she gets to eat one
Blend watermelon with lime and sugar syrup, strain, churn or freeze and scrape every 30 minutes.
K: Pineapple, orange and lemonade with sliced fruit in a punch bowl.

s.how: Cut 1kg watermelon into thick wedges. Top with 150g crumbled feta, torn mint and a squeeze of lime, then a pinch of flaky salt. Serve ice cold. Carry it in with both arms.

s.note: the after-hours dance party in the staff cabins
s.how: Cook 2 sliced onions slowly for 40 minutes until deep brown, cool and chop. Fold into 300g sour cream with salt and chives. Serve with bowls of 200g pretzels and a bag of potato chips.

m.how: Brown a 1.5kg brisket. Lay on 3 sliced onions in a roasting dish with 500ml stock, 2 tbsp tomato paste and 2 tsp sweet paprika. Cover and braise at 150C for 4 hours. Slice across the grain and spoon over the juices.

w.note: she carried a watermelon, now she gets to eat one
w.how: Blitz 1kg watermelon flesh with the juice of 2 limes and 100g sugar dissolved in 100ml hot water. Strain, pour into a tray and freeze for 4 hours, scraping with a fork every 30 minutes. Scoop into cups.

d.how: Pour 500ml pineapple juice and 500ml orange juice into a punch bowl with ice. Top with 750ml lemonade and float a sliced orange on top. Ladle into glasses.
